steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This place... is filled with fallen Reunion.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...The blood from his wounds had been frozen, but his other body parts remained intact.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is Frostleaf's technique.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Those ruins over there look like they were caused by explosives.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's probably Meteorite's work.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Frostleaf... Jessica... Meteorite... I'm sure they're still alive...)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, all the rescue squads have reached Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We've extracted all the recon squads except for Meteorite's.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No Operators were lost on this mission, but...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Everyone suffered frostbite with varying degrees of severity.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You must take note of this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Frostbite?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All our recon squads observed a special group of Reunion troops wandering around the city.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Unlike the reckless Reunion soldiers we're used to fighting, these members had a special way of fighting.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Be cautious.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I.... I understand.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, am I clear?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Very well then.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I also have some things to do.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, even if Dr. {@nickname} is very helpful, you can't rely too much on a single person.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Also, mind the rings.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit actually worries about you a lot.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Before we realized it...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dangerous beasts have bared their fangs.

options: Reunion is bearing down upon us.
Our retreat has been cut off...
These thugs really have it out for us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mm... They will do everything they can to keep us from getting away.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, we didn't come here to run away.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island will break through their ranks.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're going to rescue Meteorite's squad!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Projekt Red, do you copy?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ahh, yes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's right. I'll meet you at the slums' east entrance.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mhm. It'll just be the two of us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We'll be fine.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Just the two of us are more than enough to fight against Reunion.
